technical_preflight_disclosure.scope: one fixed-route pair and one joint-optimization solution
technical_preflight_disclosure.purpose: verify that current source can reconstruct and score saved solutions under the explicit model configuration
technical_preflight_disclosure.note: This disclosure prevents the full-population preregistration from being misrepresented as preceding the two-record technical preflight.

contract.fixed_cost_billing: one charge per distinct pair of vehicle type and physical_vehicle_id

frozen_invariants: customer visit sequence and route home depot
charging station, energy, duration, curve, day offset, and start time
all input units and all arms or modes
allowed_transformation: deterministic zero-search physical-vehicle trip packing and current-source cost evaluation under the explicit contract
complete_solution_output: solutions.jsonl.gz with one canonical complete prepared solution per raw_runs.csv record
solution_hash_rule: SHA-256 of canonical UTF-8 JSON for the complete prepared solution only

old_cost_rules.fixed_route_fixed: saved route_count multiplied by 170 CNY under the old per-trip rule

new_cost_rule: current source evaluation of the unchanged prepared solution; fixed cost is distinct physical vehicles multiplied by 170 CNY

aggregation.fixed_route_percentages: ratio of pooled arm totals, matching the sealed source study
aggregation.joint_percentages: simple mean of the 30 within-instance-seed paired percentage changes, matching the sealed source study
aggregation.percentage_sign: treatment minus control divided by control; negative means reduction

claim_to_test: Under the new contract, carbon-aware timing still lowers charging and system emissions relative to its registered comparator, while any cost direction is reported without rescue; the saved 5.1 evidence is usable only if every required solution can be reconstructed and certified under fleet authority v3.

falsification_rules.condition: pooled CARBON charging emissions change versus ASAP is greater than or equal to zero
falsification_rules.effect: reject the fixed-route charging-emissions reduction claim

falsification_rules.condition: pooled CARBON system emissions change versus ASAP is greater than or equal to zero
falsification_rules.effect: reject the fixed-route system-emissions reduction claim

falsification_rules.condition: mean paired COST_PLUS_CARBON system emissions change versus COST_ONLY is greater than or equal to zero
falsification_rules.effect: reject the joint cost-plus-carbon emissions-reduction claim

falsification_rules.condition: mean paired PURE_CARBON system emissions change versus COST_ONLY is greater than or equal to zero
falsification_rules.effect: reject the deeper pure-carbon emissions-reduction claim

falsification_rules.condition: any required saved solution cannot be reconstructed, deterministically prepared, or certified under explicit multi-trip, unbounded depot concurrency, and fleet authority v3
falsification_rules.effect: the affected old evidence cannot support paper section 5.1 under the current contract; status HALT and report the exact search scale needed

falsification_rules.condition: any route, vehicle type, charging quantity or time, customer service, source hash, or protected source hash changes during the run
falsification_rules.effect: status HALT; do not repair, rerun, subset, or search

falsification_rules.condition: the output is not exactly 11340 fixed-route pairs and 30 joint paired units with every registered arm or mode

cost_direction_rule: Any operating-cost percentage, including a direction change caused by different physical-vehicle counts, is retained and reported; it is never used to select rows or rerun.

terminal_status_rule.complete: XD_CARBON_RESCORE_COMPLETE only if all populations are complete, all invariants pass, and all solutions are current-contract feasible
terminal_status_rule.halt: HALT if current-contract support for any required 5.1 component needs route or vehicle search
